messages.heroLead: Powerful planning tools and clear insights to help you save money and achieve financial freedom.
messages.calcSub: Enter your loan details to estimate payoff timing.
messages.strategiesSub: Choose one or more options to compare strategies.
messages.lumpDesc: One payment to reduce the loan.
messages.interestComparisonSub: See how each strategy performs on its own, then compare it with the live combined result from the options you select.
messages.baselineDesc: This is the estimated interest you would pay if you kept the loan as-is, with no offset, no extra repayments, and no lump sum.
messages.offsetOnlyDesc: Based on your offset balance and offset growth.
messages.extraOnlyDesc: Based on the extra repayment amount and frequency.
messages.lumpOnlyDesc: Based on a single lump sum payment made now.
messages.offsetCardP: Shows how much interest is reduced by keeping money in offset against the loan.
messages.extraCardP: Shows the interest saving from paying extra on top of the normal repayment.
messages.lumpCardP: Shows the interest saving from putting one single payment into the loan. If the lump sum is $0, the saving will be $0.
messages.noStrategySelectedDesc: Turn on one or more strategy options to see the combined result.
messages.allSelectedStrategiesDesc: This combines your offset account, extra repayment, and one-off lump sum together.
messages.selectedComboDesc: This combines the selected strategy options currently turned on in the calculator.
messages.monthlyBreakdownSub: Based on the strategy options currently selected.
messages.monthlyInterestHint: After offset and lump sum are applied.
messages.monthlyPrincipalHint: The part reducing your loan balance.
messages.donateStep1Sub: Your donation helps cover domain and maintenance costs.
messages.donateSecure: Payments are handled securely by Stripe. This website does not store card details.
messages.donateStep2Sub: Select your donation amount in the secure Stripe checkout.
messages.donateApplePayInfo: Apple Pay can be connected once your payment processor is added.
messages.donateCreditCardInfo: Credit card payments can be connected once Stripe or another processor is added.
messages.donatePaypalInfo: PayPal can be connected once your PayPal donation link is added.
